name: Solar (Victron)
description: Live PV power and solar yield (today, month, year) read directly from a Victron GX device (Cerbo, Ekrano, Venus GX) over MQTT. Enable MQTT on LAN (TLS 8883) on the GX.

gx_host.name: GX address
gx_host.description: IP address or hostname of the Victron GX device, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or venus.local

gx_port.name: MQTT TLS port
gx_port.description: The GX broker's TLS port; 8883 unless changed
